source.title: Committee/Team Membership Application Deadlines Extended!
source.content:
The application deadline has been extended for the following committees/teams:
WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC)
WCA Communication Team (WCT)
WCA Ethics Committee (WEC)
WCA Financial Committee (WFC)
<!-- break -->
The applications are open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered. The qualities and additional details for each committee/team are linked below: 
[WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HJ9yQCHNzZ_cudu4BcrGSZUbSlU6-nK9tk2RELRm0ro/edit?usp=sharing)
[WCA Communication Team (WCT)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eNyZWerndS-oiXDm10TzwZddQnhWcc-2msyiCUF9Xlo/edit?usp=sharing)
[WCA Ethics Committee (WEC)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CgNA4X-UP2slIwu1ufMYMZmqL9pyDJp8W1yQRVuI_qc/edit?usp=sharing)
[WCA Financial Committee (WFC)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/111-0LR2gEMOpxl6-Oje-8m0KhGhiOZ9P5AMFHDghCDw/edit)

Applications are now due on **January 21, 2018, 23:59 UTC** and should be sent privately to:
WCA Disciplinary Committee: Lorenzo Vigani Poli ([lorenzo.vig@gmail.com](mailto:lorenzo.vig@gmail.com))
WCA Communication Team: Lauren Clement ([lmclement55@gmail.com](mailto:lmclement55@gmail.com))
WCA Ethics Committee: Hippolyte Moreau ([hippolyte.moreau.speedcubing@gmail.com](mailto:hippolyte.moreau.speedcubing@gmail.com))
WCA Financial Committee: Chris Hardwick ([cmhardwick@gmail.com](mailto:cmhardwick@gmail.com))

Recipients will confirm the documents are in good order or will report on deficiencies otherwise once received. The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and they must include the information specified in the committee’s respective application document.

The rights and duties of WDC, WCT, WEC, and WFC from our By-laws can be [found here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jhfRE_vnMt7-lMfl3LEmCxTVIByWeHktaJbKn6R4p20/edit?usp=sharing).

There may be an additional interview requested of candidates with the leader following application submission. The week after the application period, the committee/team will make a selection and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: 部分委员会和团队延长成员申请截止时间
translation.content:
以下委员会和团队的成员申请截止时间已延长：

- WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）
- WCA 通讯组（WCT）
- WCA 道德委员会（WEC）
- WCA 财务委员会（WFC）

申请面向所有 WCA 成员，无须目前担任职务。各委员会和团队的要求及详情见以下链接：

- [WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HJ9yQCHNzZ_cudu4BcrGSZUbSlU6-nK9tk2RELRm0ro/edit?usp=sharing)
- [WCA 通讯组（WCT）](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eNyZWerndS-oiXDm10TzwZddQnhWcc-2msyiCUF9Xlo/edit?usp=sharing)
- [WCA 道德委员会（WEC）](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CgNA4X-UP2slIwu1ufMYMZmqL9pyDJp8W1yQRVuI_qc/edit?usp=sharing)
- [WCA 财务委员会（WFC）](https://docs.google.com/document/d/111-0LR2gEMOpxl6-Oje-8m0KhGhiOZ9P5AMFHDghCDw/edit)

新的截止时间为 **2018 年 1 月 21 日 23:59 UTC**。请将申请材料私下发送给相应联系人：

- WCA 纪律委员会：Lorenzo Vigani Poli（[lorenzo.vig@gmail.com](mailto:lorenzo.vig@gmail.com)）
- WCA 通讯组：Lauren Clement（[lmclement55@gmail.com](mailto:lmclement55@gmail.com)）
- WCA 道德委员会：Hippolyte Moreau（[hippolyte.moreau.speedcubing@gmail.com](mailto:hippolyte.moreau.speedcubing@gmail.com)）
- WCA 财务委员会：Chris Hardwick（[cmhardwick@gmail.com](mailto:cmhardwick@gmail.com)）

收到申请后，联系人会确认材料是否完整，或指出需要补充之处。材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含各委员会招募文件要求的信息。

章程中规定的 WDC、WCT、WEC 和 WFC 的权利与职责可在[此处查看](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jhfRE_vnMt7-lMfl3LEmCxTVIByWeHktaJbKn6R4p20/edit?usp=sharing)。

提交申请后，候选人还可能受邀与负责人面谈。申请截止后的下一周，各委员会和团队将选出人选，待候选人接受职位后公布新成员。

感谢各位申请和支持！
